Decision 3a (B6 conformance run, owner-approved): the request carries no PKCE challenge, so NEMAR answers invalid_request before it decides that the person is not signed in, and the test expects login_required.

Decisions 3b and 3a (B6 conformance run, owner-approved): NEMAR refuses client_secret_post (discovery lists only client_secret_basic), so this module cannot pass; it stops earlier still, at the missing PKCE challenge, so the refusal at the token endpoint is not reached here (NEMAR's own token endpoint tests hold it).
Decision 3c (B6 conformance run, owner-approved): ES256 is the only signing algorithm NEMAR offers, and OpenID Connect Discovery expects RS256 to be listed.
